name: create_google_doc
description: Create a new blank Google Docs document. Optionally write initial content into it. Returns the document_id and web link. Use edit_google_doc afterwards to make further edits.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Title for the new Google Doc.

inputs.name: initial_content
inputs.description: Optional text to write into the document body immediately after creation.

outputs.description: Human-readable confirmation with the document link.
The new document's Google Docs ID.
Direct URL to open the document in a browser.
Whether initial_content was written into the document.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for create_google_doc:
- title (required): the document title as it will appear in Google Drive.
- initial_content (optional): plain text to place in the document body at creation; omit for an empty doc.
